uses.rationale: S01 has a message_thread visual block and no footage, so scene-composition draws the whole scene. It takes no other operation.
The storyboard asks for a wipe out of S01. It is a punchy, graphic move from the mess into the ordered stack. 0.4s is under half of the 3s scene, and it is use 1 of 3.
S02 has a layered_cards visual block, so scene-composition draws the whole scene.
The storyboard asks for a crossfade out of S02. It is a calm blend from the service cards into the AI tools. 0.6s is under half of the 4s scene.
S03 has a ui_demo visual block, so scene-composition draws the cursor and the two tool rows.
The storyboard asks for a crossfade out of S03. It is a soft hand-off to the closing logo card. 0.6s is under half of the 4s scene.

S04 has an end_card visual block, so scene-composition draws the supplied logo, the headline and the button. It takes no end-card-cta or logo-reveal in the same scene. S04 is the final scene, so it needs no outgoing transition recipe.
